summary: Intercorp Financial Services Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, reporting its unaudited results for the first quarter of 2026. The filing consists of a standard earnings release discussing net income of S/602 million, ROE of 19.4%, and segment performance for banking, insurance, and wealth management. No special-situation transaction is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results, not a special situation.
